name: PDDF Shape-Fitting Loss
definition: L_d is the minimum distance loss, which trains the highest probability depth component. i* = arg max_j w_j is the maximum likelihood PDDF index.
summary: The PDDF Shape-Fitting Loss trains Probabilistic Directed Distance Fields by combining geometric, visibility, and regularization terms to model depth as discrete delta functions, distinguishing itself by enforcing transitions at surface discontinuities.
